verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents a reconciliation report suite that covers the per-payout breakdown half of the story: a Payouts Report, a Financial Actions by Payout ID Report, a Settlement Breakdown Report and a Settlement Statement, mapping payouts to the underlying financial actions and fee categories. Nothing in the pack shows a finance-ops user can set or change the payout schedule; the settlements page only mentions an optional transfer of settlement-ready funds to a stablecoin wallet. Missing for 10: control over payout schedule or frequency, detail on how charges, fees and refunds are itemized within each payout, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
